Tooltip_MDB_UpgradeBagTier1: The bag must be at tier 0 and not worn. Items inside can stay. The server sets the highest tier.
Tooltip_MDB_UpgradeBagTier2: The bag must be at tier 1 and not worn. Items inside can stay. The server sets the highest tier.
Tooltip_MDB_UpgradeBagTier3: The bag must be at tier 2 and not worn. Items inside can stay. The server sets the highest tier.
Tooltip_MDB_RestoreReinforced: The tier is kept, with the original bag's stats at that tier (capacity, weight, run speed and so on). The bag must not be worn. Items inside can stay.
Tooltip_MDB_LegacyBag:
Old Plus bag: convert it to the reinforced version to keep using it.
Until then, items can be taken out but not put in.
To convert: take it off, bring a needle and thread to a table, and right-click the bag:
"Convert Old Plus Bag to Reinforced".
It becomes the same bag, reinforced, at the highest tier. Items inside can stay.
